questions.q: Which of the following scenarios best represents the concept of 'Complementary Proteins' in a vegan diet?
options: Drinking almond milk with soy protein powder.
questions.explain: Legumes (beans) are limiting in methionine but high in lysine. Grains (rice) are limiting in lysine but high in methionine. Eating them together provides all essential amino acids, forming a complete protein profile.
